editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your own body has been turned into a weapon against your will. You are following a guy who works for a secret company, but things go south when he becomes the test subject for a scary new weapons project. Now, he is a half-man, half-robot killer who has to destroy everything in his path because of his programming. It feels like a wild trip back to the eighties where the science is fake, but the tension is real. You get a mix of sci-fi dread and old-school action that keeps you wondering if he can ever get his humanity back.

The action scenes are pretty gritty, and the special effects have that chunky, practical look that makes it feel like a true relic of its time. While the pacing slows down in some spots, the mystery of the company keeps you glued to the screen. If you love weird cyborg stories, you should definitely check this out. It is a great pick to stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or you could rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The main character finally fights back against the evil company that changed him. In the final showdown, he uses his robotic strength to take down the people responsible for his pain. After a big fight, he manages to break free from the programming that forced him to kill. The movie ends with him finding a way to stop being a weapon, giving him a chance to live as a man again instead of a machine.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s cyborg movies and secret government plots.
